purpose: Describe one change developing together with another.
keywords: Change verb dictionary form / change noun + につれて
It got colder as evening fell.
I gained confidence as I kept practicing.
The shop’s products change along with the seasons.
formation: Change verb dictionary form / change noun + につれて
restrictions: Both clauses normally describe gradual change, not a deliberate instruction.
mistake: Use に従って for obeying guidance; につれて does not express that meaning.
